top.author: @abukawserahamed
top.text: Open rates don’t tell the full story. Apple MPP inflates opens. Spam folder emails can still show as opened. Inbox placement is the real metric that matters. Stop guessing. Start testing. #EmailMarketing #Deliverability #ColdEmail
top.translationZh: 邮件打开率数据不能说明全部问题。苹果的邮件隐私保护功能会虚增打开数据。垃圾邮件文件夹里的邮件也可能显示为已打开。真正重要的指标是邮件能否成功到达收件箱。别再瞎猜了，开始做测试吧。#EmailMarketing #Deliverability #ColdEmail
